TENANCY AGREEMENT (ROOM RENTAL) - SAMPLE FOR TESTING ONLY

This Agreement is made between the Landlord and the Tenant for one common room at Block 123 Clementi Avenue 3, Singapore (the "Premises").

1. Term. The term of the tenancy is twelve (12) months, commencing on 1 January 2027.
2. Rent. The monthly rent is S$1,250, payable in advance on the 1st day of each month by bank transfer.
3. Deposit. The Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to one month's rent. A booking fee of S$300 is non-refundable.
4. The Landlord may enter the Premises at any time to inspect the room.
5. Utilities. Electricity and water are capped at S$50 per month; any excess shall be shared equally. Wi-Fi is included.
6. Repairs. The Tenant shall bear the cost of any and all repairs to the room and its furniture.
7. House rules. Light cooking is allowed. No overnight guests without the Landlord's consent.
8. The Landlord may revise the rent at its sole discretion after six months.
